name: 现场物流计划与执行 - 集装箱和航次 (6BA)
name_en: Field Logistics Planning and Execution – Containers and Voyages (6BA)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item supports the use of containers and voyages in the logistics between a supplying base and remote locations. It enables creation of master data for containers, visibility into the packing of products into these containers, and voyage creation and tracking between the base and remote locations.

This covers the following aspects:

• Container master data and container certificates

• Voyage creation manually and through an API (from other SAP or third-party systems)

• Support of different supply and return scenarios for stock, nonstock, supplier items

• Packing of products in containers for an outbound process

• Voyage changes, dispatching, rerouting

• Receipt for containers and voyages at base and remote locations with handling decisions for quick processing

Key Process Flow

• Create voyage

• Create container master data

• Pack deliveries into a container and post goods issue, using QR code scan to pack

• Assign containers, handling units, or shipment items to a voyage in the supply and return process

• Receipt at base and remote locations for items associated with containers and voyages, using QR code scan to identify

• Process returns at base location within containers and voyages

• Send and receive empty containers

Business Benefits

  • Track containers as master data and during the supply and return processing between supplying base and remote locations
  • Integrate with materials management, procurement, warehouse management, and logistics execution
  • Track the progress of the transportation through voyages
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目支持在供应基地和远程位置之间的物流中使用集装箱和航次。它支持为容器创建主数据，查看将产品包装到这些容器中，以及在基地和远程位置之间创建和跟踪航次。

这涵盖以下方面：

• 容器主数据和容器证书

• 手动和通过 API（来自其他 SAP 或第三方系统）创建航次

• 支持库存、非库存、供应商项目的不同供应和退货场景

• 在容器中包装产品，以便进行出库流程

• 航次更改、分派、重排路线

• 在基地和远程位置接收集装箱和航次，并制定处理决策，以便快速处理

关键流程流

• 创建航次

• 创建容器主数据

• 将交货装入容器并过账发货，使用二维码扫描进行打包

• 在供应和退货流程中将容器、处理单元或装运项目分配到航次

• 在基地和远程位置接收与集装箱和航次相关的项目，使用二维码扫描进行识别

• 在集装箱和航次内的基地处理退货

• 发送和接收空容器

业务优势

  • 在供应基地和远程位置之间的供应和退货处理期间，将集装箱作为主数据进行跟踪
  • 集成物料管理、采购、仓库管理和物流执行
  • 通过航次跟踪运输进度
